subject: NebulaAI pilot — request for short trial hold while interop work finishes
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@nebula.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv@nebula.ai>, platformops@nebula.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot progress and a request for temporary hold

Hi Karthik,

Quick update from our side — thanks again for the onboarding session yesterday. Our backend team hit an unexpected blocker with the webhook handshake to Redwood's sandbox (auth token exchange fails intermittently during high concurrency). We scoped the issue and it looks like a 2–3 sprint task to stabilize (we're tracking it internally).

Because the integration hiccup will push our demo and metrics collection out by at least two weeks, we'd like to request a short pause on token consumption for the pilot and an extension of the trial window so the evaluation period doesn't get truncated.

Specific ask:
- Pause current trial token burn for up to 14 days, effective immediately if possible.
- Extend pilot end date by 14 days (new proposed end: 2027-08-05).

I can share the error logs and a succinct QA plan if helpful — attaching the first dump we pulled. We're keen to keep momentum but don't want to test at lower fidelity.

Appreciate any flexibility here — happy to set a quick call if you prefer.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Platform Integrations | NebulaAI
~ elena@nebula.ai

Attachment: nebula_error_log_20270715.txt (text)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@nebula.ai>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot progress and a request for temporary hold

Elena — thanks for the clear note and for sending the log. I'm sorry you're hitting that at a critical time. We want the pilot to reflect your production flow, not a diminished integration.

Operationally we can offer two things to keep the project healthy while you stabilize:
1) A 14-day extension to the pilot end date (we can set to 2027-08-05)
2) A temporary freeze of token accounting on the sandbox project for up to 14 days so your team can run controlled tests without eating into trial credits

Before I lock this in: can Dev confirm the specific webhook scenario that fails (concurrency threshold, payload size, auth refresh cadence)? If it's a quick config tweak we can workaround sooner.

I looped in Dev Patel (our SE) and Lauren (CS lead) — Dev, can you review Elena's log and advise whether this looks like a client-side backoff or something server-side on our sandbox mesh?

If agreed, I'll update the HubSpot deal with the extension and put the service-side freeze in place.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Related link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/NB-2027-341

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Elena Martinez <elena@nebula.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot progress and a request for temporary hold

On Fri, Jul 16, 2027 at 9:21 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Dev, can you review Elena's log and advise whether this looks like a client-side backoff or something server-side on our sandbox mesh?

Thanks — I pulled the attached log (thanks Elena) and did a short repro in our staging. Summary:
- Symptom: intermittent 401 followed by a cascade of retries; appears when concurrent workers hit >120 requests/sec with short-lived tokens
- Root cause (likely): your token refresh TTL is set to 30s; combined with our short-lived session handoff it causes racey refreshes and occasional invalid signatures at scale
- Workarounds:
  * Client change: increase refresh window to 90s and linearize refresh requests (one process refreshes shared token) — low-risk and quick (1–2 engineer days)
  * Server-side mitigation: we can relax validation window for sandbox for 14 days to tolerate the current TTL while you rollout fixes

I recommend doing both: we can apply the sandbox relaxation immediately (no infra deploy required) and you can ship the client fix on your next sprint. If you want, I can prepare a short runbook and a one-hour co-debug session next Tuesday.

Attaching a minimal repro and a proposed sprint plan.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-sprint-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elena Martinez <elena@nebula.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv@nebula.ai>, platformops@nebula.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot progress and a request for temporary hold

Thanks Karthik and Dev — this is exactly the kind of clear plan we needed. Please proceed with:
- Sandbox token-validation relaxation for 14 days starting now
- Pilot end date moved to 2027-08-05
- One-hour debug session on Tue 20 Jul to walk through the repro (I'll bring our lead engineer)

We'll prioritize the client refresh window change. I'll confirm the attendee list for Tuesday. Appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform Integrations | NebulaAI
